hook.text: She knows 25 cartoon songs. Not one word about Allah.

verses.text: “Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].”

end.text: She knows 25 cartoon songs. Not one word about Allah.
end.gold: Today, teach her one line of Al-Fatihah. Just one.

captions: You counted tonight. Twenty-five. You taught her most of them.
9:40 p.m. Stars turn slowly on her ceiling.
You tuck the blanket under her chin. She hums the theme song.
Then she opens her eyes: “Daddy, who made the stars?”
You open your mouth. Nothing comes.
You haven't said His name out loud in months.
Next morning. Her small hand in yours. The mosque fountain.
You show her the water. Hands, mouth, face. She giggles.
Two words. The first you've ever taught her for Allah.

post.caption:
She knows 25 cartoon songs. Not one word about Allah. 🌙

9:40 p.m., stars turning on her ceiling, and she asks: “Daddy, who made the stars?” — and you have no words ready.

“Your Lord has not taken leave of you.” (93:3)

Today, teach her one line of Al-Fatihah. Just one.
